content: The intended audience for privacy policies consists of the general public. This informs the decision to elicit questions from crowdworkers on the contents of privacy policies. We choose not to show the contents of privacy policies to crowdworkers, a procedure motivated by a desire to avoid inadvertent biases BIBREF43, BIBREF44, BIBREF45, BIBREF46, BIBREF47, and encourage crowdworkers to ask a variety of questions beyond only asking questions based on practices described in the document.
